score_rationale: Clear pain (monthly rounding errors, manual edits) and a narrow first release. Value depends on how many invoices carry discounts, which the idea does not say.
summary: Add percentage discount codes with expiry to invoicekit, applied to the subtotal before tax, rounded like all other money, and recorded per invoice for audit.

gaps.question: Can more than one code apply to the same invoice?
gaps.why_it_matters: Stacking changes the calculation order and the audit record.

gaps.question: Is the expiry date inclusive, and in which time zone?
gaps.why_it_matters: Codes used on the last day will be accepted or refused inconsistently otherwise.

gaps.question: Who creates and revokes codes?
gaps.why_it_matters: Without an owner, codes leak and cannot be withdrawn.

epics.title: Percentage discount codes
epics.description: Model a discount code with a percentage and apply it to the invoice subtotal before tax.
epics.source_quote: A discount code gives a percentage off the invoice subtotal before tax

stories.title: Apply a percentage discount code to an invoice
acceptance_criteria: Discount is a percentage of the subtotal, applied before tax
Tax is calculated on the discounted subtotal

stories.title: Show the discount as its own line in totals
acceptance_criteria: total() equals subtotal minus discount plus tax

epics.title: Code expiry
epics.description: Refuse codes after their expiry date.
epics.source_quote: each code has an expiry date after which it must be refused

stories.title: Refuse expired discount codes
acceptance_criteria: Applying a code after its expiry date raises an error
A code is valid on its expiry date

epics.title: Exact rounding
epics.description: Round discounted amounts with the same Decimal rules as all other money.
epics.source_quote: the discounted total to be rounded exactly like every other amount, to the cent

stories.title: Round discounts half-up to the currency minor unit
acceptance_criteria: No float arithmetic anywhere in the discount path

epics.title: Audit of applied codes
epics.description: Record which code was applied to each invoice.
epics.source_quote: see which code was applied to each invoice for audit

stories.title: Record the applied code on the invoice
acceptance_criteria: Invoice keeps the applied code identifier
Applying a second code replaces the first and is visible

director_report.summary: Small, well-bounded change that removes manual edits and the monthly rounding errors finance reports. First release is percentage codes only.
director_report.decision_requested: Approve the first release of percentage codes with expiry and audit.
